title: GTC Disclosure Manifest
description: Ground Truth Credential deployer-side disclosure manifest. Each manifest accompanies a piece of AI-assisted content and declares the structural conditions under which it was produced.

schema_version.description: Version of the GTC manifest schema. The visual mark is version-independent; versioning lives here.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this manifest. Format: gtc-[content-identifier]-[YYYY-MM-DD]. Example: gtc-glasswing-014-2026-08-12.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of manifest creation. Git commit timestamp provides independent verification.

deployer.description: The person or entity that produced and published the content. The deployer is the party making the disclosure, not the AI provider.

name.description: Legal name or professional identity of the deployer. Example: Dee Jared Johnson.

organization.description: Organization the deployer represents, if any. Example: Cognitive Fusion.

role.description: Deployer's role relevant to the content. Example: Author, Editor, Publisher.

content.description: Metadata about the content this manifest accompanies.

title.description: Title of the content. Example: The Glasswing Translator, Issue 014.

url.description: Canonical URL where the content is published.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the final published content. This is the hard binding between the manifest and the content.

hash_method.description: Hash algorithm used. SHA-256 is the only supported method in v0.1.

hash_scope.description: What was hashed. Example: full HTML of published page, raw text body excluding navigation, PDF file bytes.

ai_system.description: The AI system(s) used in producing the content.

provider.description: Company that built the AI system. Example: Anthropic.

system.description: Name of the AI system or model. Example: Claude.

model_version.description: Specific model version if known. Example: claude-sonnet-4-6.

usage_type.description: How the AI system was used in content production.

usage_description.description: Free-text description of AI involvement. Example: Claude drafted the prose from DJJ's structural claims and editorial direction.

disclosures.description: Structured conflict declarations. Each disclosure names a specific structural relationship or conflict between the deployer, the AI provider, and the content's subject matter. This is the core of GTC — the layer that provider-side provenance does not provide.

type.description: Category of the structural conflict or relationship being disclosed.

statement.description: Plain-language declaration of the conflict. This should be specific and verifiable, not boilerplate. Example: The model used to produce this analysis was built by the company this analysis critiques.

severity.description: Severity classification. Structural: the conflict is inherent to the production method and cannot be mitigated. Material: the conflict could influence the content's conclusions. Contextual: the relationship exists but is unlikely to influence the content.

mitigation.description: What the deployer did to address the conflict, if anything. Example: Structural claims are DJJ's; prose is Claude's. The conflict is named, not resolved.

prior_manifests.description: References to GTC manifests for earlier content in the same publication or series. Creates a verifiable disclosure chain.

manifest_id.description: The manifest_id of the prior manifest.

url.description: URL to the prior manifest file.

manifest_url.description: Canonical URL of this manifest file. Example: https://github.com/djaredj/ground-truth-credential/blob/main/manifests/glasswing-014.json.

verification_page.description: URL of the verification lookup page. Example: https://djaredj.github.io/ground-truth-credential/verify/.

git_commit.description: Git commit SHA that added or last modified this manifest. Provides independent timestamp verification.

notes.description: Optional free-text field for additional context not covered by structured fields.
